button_group() renders a row of styled action buttons (primary, secondary, outline, destructive, ghost). Click any button below to see the dispatched action payload. { "type": "button_group", "buttons": [ {"label": "Run Agent", "action": "run_agent", "variant": "primary"}, {"label": "Dry Run", "action": "dry_run", "variant": "outline"}, {"label": "Clear Cache", "action": "clear_cache", "variant": "destructive"} ] }
Parameter Type Description buttons list[dict] Button specs with label, action (or href), optional variant, and optional payload.
